summary.short: Amends Anatel's telecom product conformity and homologation rules: makes online marketplaces jointly liable with sellers for non-homologated products, widens sanctionable conduct, and adds a Title VI-A requiring conformity assessment of telecom-network data centers before operation (its enforceability is suspended per the document).
summary.long: Amends Anatel's telecom product conformity and homologation regulation (Resolução 715/2019). Art. 1 revokes two provisions. Art. 2 makes marketplaces and other digital platforms involved in selling a product jointly liable with the seller, including for disclosing and checking its homologation code. Art. 3 revises arts. 83-85 to list sanctionable conduct, extends responsibility to platforms for irregular online offers, and allows removal of designated bodies after due process. Art. 4 limits certification of reconditioned products to public-policy purposes; Art. 5 applies the Consumer Protection Code subsidiarily. Art. 6 adds Title VI-A: data centers integrated into telecom networks need conformity assessment before operation, under a procedure due within 240 days; providers may then install or contract only certified new centers, and existing ones have three years to comply. Requirements cover continuous operation, physical and cyber security, energy efficiency and environmental practices. As the document notes, Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 suspended Art. 6's enforceability pending reassessment. Art. 7: in force on publication, except Arts. 2 and 3, which take effect four months later.

notes: Art. 6 (new Título VI-A on data centers that integrate telecom networks) is suspended per Acordão nº 58 of 3 March 2026, quoted in the text, pending reassessment; the title text is reproduced as adopted. Art. 7: the Resolution enters into force on publication, except arts. 2 and 3, which enter into force 4 months after entry into force (dated relative to entry into force; no fixed date stated). Art. 2 (marketplace joint liability) and Art. 3 (expanded conduct list) are therefore not yet in force on the text's own terms. The text states it does not replace the DOU publication of 4/8/2025. Category-level addressees (marketplaces and digital platforms, telecom providers, data centers) are not listed as named entities.

thresholds.note: The text contains numbers but none is a cutoff that changes legal treatment. Art. 85-B §1 (240 days), §3 (3 years) and Art. 7 par. único (4 months) are procedural periods and are coded as events. Art. 85 III (up to 2 years) is an enforcement measure. Art. 85-B applies to data centers integrating telecommunications networks without a numeric size or capacity test. Art. 6 is noted in the text as suspended by Acórdão nº 58, de 3 de março de 2026 (text-internal, not coded here).

definitions.note: The instrument contains no defined terms. Scope-determining phrases such as 'data centers que integram as redes de telecomunicações' (Art. 85-A) and 'plataformas intermediadoras de comércio eletrônico (marketplaces)' (Art. 2, Art. 3 §2) appear in operative provisions without a definition. 'Organismo de Certificação Designado' and 'Requisito Técnico' are referenced but not defined in this text.
